info.title: AI Ecosystem Contracts
info.description: Public prefix is stripped by the proxy. Service APIs require scoped authentication. Simulation schema and presets may be publicly readable; runs require a sandbox session. Contract mocks are not product implementations.

post.description: Optional capability. Return NOT_FOUND when cancellation is not supported; terminal runs return their unchanged status.

get.description: Accept text/event-stream for SSE or application/json for polling. Last-Event-ID is the last received integer sequence. See docs/PROTOCOL.md.

text/event-stream.example:
: heartbeat

id: 1
event: step
data: {"see":"simulation-event schema"}

sandboxSession.description: Short-lived sandbox session. Obtain from the project-specific same-origin session bootstrap; never a provider key.

serviceBearer.description: Audience, tenant, environment and scope-bound service credential.
